translations.web: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to Yahweh only, shall be utterly destroyed.
translations.bsb: If anyone sacrifices to any god other than the LORD alone, he must be set apart for destruction.
translations.kjv: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto the LORD only, he shall be utterly destroyed.
translations.asv: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto Jehovah only, shall be utterly destroyed.
